description: MeerKAT noise diode to sky cross-hand (H-V) phase correction: cubic B-spline in frequency (MHz), values in degrees, scipy.interpolate.splev(freq_MHz, (knots, coefs, k)). The diode X-Y phase median over the antennas plus this spline is the sky H-V phase (katsdpcal Scan.bcross_to_sky, for 'hv' polarisation order: the gains are divided out as V_hv / (g_h g_v*), BCROSS_DIODE_SKY g_h = median(BCROSS_DIODE) * exp(i spline)).
source: katsdpcal (https://github.com/ska-sa/katsdpcal, commit dc1f4e1, 2026-07-24), katsdpcal/conf/pipeline_params/pipeline_parameters_meerkat_{UHF,L,S}_wide.txt, parameters bcross_sky_knots, bcross_sky_coefs, bcross_sky_k.
